name: Remnants of Dawn
detailed_description:
Dante Jones is a college freshman with a bright future ahead. He’s a rising football star with a full athletic scholarship, decent grades, and a slew of fellow students vying for his friendship… but when Dante injures himself jumping from the balcony of a frat house, the experimental treatment he undergoes at the college clinic is anything but ordinary. Something visits him in the night… something with sharp fangs, luminous eyes, and a wicked smile.

Dante can’t explain it, but something inside him has changed. The sun burns, not only his eyes but his flesh. He’s hungry all the time. His senses are more acute, and the world feels brighter; louder.

Nick Torres knows exactly what’s happening. Nick, a deadbeat monster slayer living out of a trailer in the backwoods, has been on the hunt for a master vampire for the past ten years. Finally hot on the trail and following clues to the local college, Nick enrolls, and connects with the newly-turned vampire, Dante.

Together, aided by friends (and enemies) old and new, the pair set out seeking the master vampire that has disrupted both their lives -- Dante, eager to find a cure for his newfound vampirism; Nick, so he can finally put the ghosts of his past to rest.

Remnants of Dawn is an immersive horror-thriller visual novel with a branching interactive story and impactful choices. Strive to stay alive, and maybe even solve a murder – or two – or three – as mystery and mayhem abound in this dark and compelling supernatural adventure.


Immersive interactive story - Influence how the narrative unfolds through a myriad of meaningful choices as your perspective switches between the often opposing viewpoints of Dante and Nick.

Custom art and illustration - More than a dozen character sprites with hundreds of variations, beautifully painted backdrops, and key art in critical moments contribute to crafting a deeply engaging visual experience.

A broad cast of diverse characters - Get to know a unique and inclusive lineup incorporating thoughtful and compelling representation across the board.

Original soundtrack - Over an hour of masterfully crafted and memorable background music contributes to setting the tone, varying from moments of humor and joy to horror and despair.


Remnants of Dawn incorporates mature themes including alcohol abuse, physical violence, psychological trauma, and visual and written depictions of gore.

While Remnants of Dawn does not utilize jump scares, some players may find the visual and audio effects disturbing.

Remnants of Dawn is a standalone story, but Nick's narrative begins elsewhere. Catch a glimpse into this emotionally traumatized man's past by exploring the Up All Night series.

short_description: A string of campus killings. A newly-turned vampire struggling to adjust. A monster hunter seeking answers. Worlds collide as Dante Jones and Nick Torres, both in danger of being accused of the crimes, team up to reveal the true culprit in this chilling supernatural horror visual novel.
